🎯 Defining Probability

This lesson reviews core probability ideas, including valid probability ranges, theoretical and empirical probability, and how probability expresses uncertainty.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a probability question, and you type the correct value or concept from memory.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback appears after every response, so you can compare your answer to the correct probability idea right away.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings back the concepts you are still mixing up and spaces out the ones you already understand.

Focus on the wording of each scenario and whether it is asking about likelihood, observed frequency, or a probability rule, then begin when you are ready.
